inputs.issue: Two bug reports about CSV import (src/importer.py and the modules it uses). 1) An import file that lists the same new SKU twice is accepted, although the rules say a SKU may appear at most once per file. 2) When a line in the middle of a file is invalid, the import fails but the lines before it are already applied, although import_csv promises all or nothing. Fix both so the documented behaviour holds. Do not change the tests.
